name: silvershop-suite/api
description: Headless REST API for SilverShop (SilverStripe CMS 6): catalog/cart/order/customer resources, token auth with scopes, pagination, pluggable resources/serializers and order webhooks. A backwards-compatible superset of core's api/v1.

suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-queuedjobs: Deliver webhooks as a background job instead of inline during the request.
suggest.silvershop-suite/search: Exposes the instant product-search bridge at api/v1/search.
suggest.silvershop-suite/brands: Enriches the product resource with brand fields.
suggest.silvershop-suite/colors: Enriches the product resource with colour swatches.
suggest.silvershop-suite/reviews: Enriches the product resource with aggregate rating fields.
suggest.silvershop-suite/product-gallery: Enriches the product resource with gallery image URLs.
